description: Délai estimatif de raccordement producteur BT supérieur à 36kVA is a dataset listed in SRD OpenData open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by SRD. Ce jeu de données est lié à la visualisation suivante: Visualisation - Délai estimatif de raccordement producteur BT supérieur à 36kVA. Coverage: Vienne (SRD electricity network). Its keywords are BT, Raccordement. The portal shows 587 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2024-08-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte version 2.0 (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-srd-energies-fr-portal.
